title: 认识新同学：问来自哪里并发现共同点
subtitle: 从姓名、家乡到专业，用后续问题自然交朋友

audio.title: Meeting other students
audio.note: 官方音频总长约 1:42；本课已实际打开并连续播放核验 0:00–1:10（70 秒）。来源页提供完整 transcript；先无字幕听姓名、家乡与所学科目。

sections.title: 1｜无字幕先听（5 分钟）
sections.body: 第一遍听 0:00–1:10，不暂停，只抓三个人的名字和谈话主题。第二遍记下 Cara 来自哪里、Robert 住在哪里、Selim 在哪里长大。先不看 transcript，回答后再核对，并关文字重听。
questions: 三位学生叫什么名字，他们为什么开始交谈？
Cara、Robert 和 Selim 分别提到了哪些地方？
sections.answers:
1. Cara、Robert 和 Selim；老师让大家向旁边的人做自我介绍。
2. Cara 来自 Glasgow；Robert 住在 Manchester 附近；Selim 来自 Leeds，后来在 London 附近长大。

sections.title: 2｜精听辨音、连读弱读与跟读（4 分钟）
sections.body:
精听三处：
1. “And you are?”：and 常弱读，you are 连得很近，用来邀请对方报姓名。
2. “Where are you from?”：Where are 连读，are 弱而短，from 承担信息重点。
3. “What about you?”：what about 连起来，about 首音弱，you 是对比重点。

每处先听 3 次，再看文字跟读两遍；随后关文字影子跟读，最后重听整段。不要在地名没听清时停住。
sections.answers: 对话推进结构：自报姓名 → 问对方 → 问家乡 → 追问居住地 → 把问题转给第三个人。

sections.title: 3｜原创阅读（4 分钟）
sections.body: On the first day of an evening photography course, Maya sat beside two students she had never met. The teacher asked everyone to introduce themselves. Maya said her name and explained that she was from Chengdu but now lived in Haikou. One student, Liam, said he had visited Chengdu and loved the food there. Instead of ending the conversation, Maya asked what he liked to photograph. Liam enjoyed street scenes, while the other student, Nora, preferred portraits. Maya liked both, so they discovered an easy topic for future conversations. They exchanged contact details and agreed to practise together before the next class. Maya had felt shy at first, but simple questions made the situation easier. Asking where someone is from, what they study and what they enjoy can quickly reveal a shared interest without making the conversation feel like an interview.
questions: What shared topic helped the students continue talking?
What did they agree to do before the next class?
sections.translation: 在夜间摄影课的第一天，玛雅坐在两位从未见过的学生旁边。老师让每个人做自我介绍。玛雅说出名字，并解释自己来自成都，但现在住在海口。一位叫利亚姆的学生说他去过成都，很喜欢那里的食物。玛雅没有让对话结束，而是问他喜欢拍什么。利亚姆喜欢街景，另一位学生诺拉更喜欢人像。玛雅两者都喜欢，于是他们找到了以后容易聊的话题。他们交换联系方式，并约好下次课前一起练习。玛雅开始有些害羞，但简单的问题让场面轻松起来。询问对方来自哪里、学什么、喜欢什么，可以很快发现共同兴趣，又不会让谈话像面试。
sections.answers:
1. Photography, especially street scenes and portraits.
2. They agreed to practise together.

sections.title: 4｜词汇与高频词块（4 分钟）
sections.body:
1. Nice to meet you.｜很高兴认识你。（高频词块）
Nice to meet you, Liam.｜很高兴认识你，利亚姆。
2. Where are you from?｜你来自哪里？（高频词块）
Where are you from originally?｜你最初来自哪里？
3. I grew up in ...｜我在……长大。（高频词块）
I grew up in a small town.｜我在一个小镇长大。
4. What about you?｜你呢？（高频词块）
I study history. What about you?｜我学历史，你呢？
5. What are you studying?｜你在学什么？（高频词块）
What are you studying this year?｜你今年在学什么？
6. That's interesting.｜真有意思。（高频词块）
That's interesting. How did you choose it?｜真有意思，你怎么选择它的？
7. We have that in common.｜我们有这个共同点。（高频词块）
You like photography too? We have that in common.｜你也喜欢摄影？我们有这个共同点。
8. originally｜最初；原来
I'm originally from Leeds.｜我最初来自利兹。
9. introduce yourself｜自我介绍
Please introduce yourself to the group.｜请向小组做自我介绍。

sections.title: 5｜语法：be from 与 grow up 的区别（3 分钟）
sections.body:
be from 表示来自哪里；grow up 用一般过去时 grew up，表示在哪里长大。两处可能相同，也可能不同。

例句：
1. I'm from Leeds.｜我来自利兹。
2. I grew up near London.｜我在伦敦附近长大。

练习：
1. 填空：I ___ from Glasgow.
2. 填空：She ___ up near Manchester.

sections.title: 6｜原创对话、替换与快速回应（2 分钟）
sections.body:
双人对话：
A: Hi, I'm Maya. And you are?
B: I'm Leo. Nice to meet you.
A: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
B: I'm from Xi'an, but I grew up in Shenzhen. What about you?
A: I'm from Haikou. What are you studying?
B: Business English.
A: That's interesting. I'm studying English too, so we have that in common.

替换练习：
1. Xi'an / Shenzhen / Business English → Chengdu / Beijing / history。
2. studying English → playing Apex，并追问喜欢哪种武器。

快速回应（5 秒内）：
1. 对方报姓名：回应并问家乡。
2. 对方说在深圳长大：问现在住哪里。
3. 发现都喜欢游戏：说出共同点。

口头任务（30–60 秒）：介绍姓名、来自哪里、在哪里长大、现在学什么或做什么，再问对方两个后续问题。
sections.answers: 参考：1. Nice to meet you. Where are you from? 2. Where do you live now? 3. We both like games—we have that in common.

sections.title: 7｜复习上一课与反馈（1 分钟）
sections.body:
复习 3 个词块：
1. leave a message｜留言
2. call someone back｜给某人回电话
3. Could you please ...?｜你可以……吗？

各造一句。回原聊天告诉我第一遍听懂比例、最卡的地名或连读句；也可发英文或语音完成自我介绍。只有实际收到并分析语音后，我才评价发音。
sections.answers: 自检：不看文字说出 Where are you from? / I grew up in ... / What about you?
